notes.title: Alpha 2 Update
notes.notes:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2309350/Disease_Z__Zombie_City/

[i]Hello survivors, after a long time without updates I present to you the biggest update, with life improvements, optimization, bug resolution and more.

Disease Z will be at the Steam Vem ai event from October 9th to 16th from 2pm, with live with Dev. Don't forget to put Disease Z on your wish list.[/i]

[b][u]Added description to items[/u][/b]
[i]Added item descriptions to find out the features and make it easier to understand the item.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43904910/a7f6c2098424d0318db2a4b3d9b6b4e423b00034.png[/img]
-

[u][b]New Zombie System[/b][/u]
Ai dos Zombies has been remade, it's still not 100% as I would like but it's better than it was before. Now I've set him to only appear when he's at a distance
-

[u][b]Consumable items can be used with double click[/b][/u]
Very useful functionality if you're in a hurry, now consumable and equippable items are being used by double-clicking on the items, be careful not to eat a tricked-out pot of sugar and die from giving in afterwards.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43904910/a8d85010b1ffba06d56e3a0316b409833f6be886.gif[/img]
-

[u][b]Improved crafting system [/b][/u]
Thinking about improvements, the creation table and manual creation has been improved with the ability to create all or a portion of what you want.
-

[u][b]Wood/stone collection animations can now be cut[/b][/u]
Now you can exit a wood or stone cutting animation if an enemy comes up behind you, making it easier for you to eliminate them without causing damage.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43904910/2e83c5528b1f70dd3fd0fd6845fbd234e3befa15.gif[/img]
-

[b][u]Adjusted character aiming bug[/u][/b]
When you aim with the right button, the crosshair should zoom to improve aiming so you can hit more distant targets.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43904910/1b26377e9678f7ef1ba92aef54cfea7ae8ac2164.gif[/img]
-

[u][b]New save game system[/b][/u]
The save game system works in 2 ways, when you place a bed inside your house, you can save manually, but now the game has an automatic save every 5 minutes, if the game closes on its own.
-

[u][b]New game tutorial[/b][/u]
I created a video tutorial of basic principles to start playing in Disease Z, it's not the final tutorial yet as I plan on adding more things to the tutorial, but it's good to get started.
-

[u][b]FPS optimization (20-25 to 25-35)[/b][/u]
With the new zombie system I managed to improve the optimization a little, along with the new Options Menu you can make the game a little lighter or heavier depending on the configuration you put in.
-

[u][b]New start map[/b][/u]
The safe zone map was added as a tutorial to get you started and familiarize yourself with the commands and some items before venturing into the world.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43904910/9b732fcb5634e06199805b78d615cdabb29b7067.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43904910/ddaf35e98cf11d72689cf4c1fb08d67edeb850df.png[/img]
-

[u][b]New Options Menu[/b][/u]
Options Menu has been remodeled now with many more graphic options, audio configuration, key map used among other things that still doesn't work as I wanted.
-

[i]Fixed several bugs reported by the community. Thank you to everyone who sent feedback via email and the community hub, you don't know how great this is for the game[/i]. ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Alpha 1 Update - 24 July 2023
notes.notes:
[h1]Update Notes[/h1]

[i]Hello Guys, this will be the first Demo update, we have some new stuff, updates and bug fixes.
There are still bugs, over time we are solving and updating them here in the update notes, so you know what is being resolved and added to the game.[/i]


[h2]Added/Updated/Optimized[/h2]

Darkest night
Usage of [b]WOOD LOG[/b] for [b]WOOD PLANK[/b] is now 1x1 instead of 3x1
[b]SCRAP METAL [/b] usage for [b]IRON INGOT[/b] is now 2x1 instead of 5x1
Item refining time [b]SCRAP METAL [/b] to [b]IRON INGOT[/b] from 45sec to 30sec
Thirst and Hunger consuming a little slower
Now Stamina will last a little longer and will recover faster
Added Loading Screen
Added Videos of the beginning of the game with warnings
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43904910/ac41406f32154a01f4840a4e09bef6caf75c9c71.png[/img]
Post Processing to improve lighting
Applied [b]Lumen[/b] technology on the map
Technology [b]Direct X 12[/b]
Increased by [u][b]10[/b][/u] ~ [u][b]15[/b][/u] [u][b]FPS[/b][/u] depending on PC ːsteamhappyː



[h2]Bugs Solved[/h2]

Shadows on the map have serious re-rendering issues
Character's shadow inside the inventory turned dark
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43904910/8a6c32b66e5f846dfebfbf97d6fca9453a8d2338.png[/img]
Backpack Inventory the items in the right column you couldn't move
Some buildings were not destroying with the "X" button
Collectable items when collecting remained on the map (Tree, Stone, Nest and Fruit)
When you collected a Herb, an image of an orange appeared
corrected texts


[h2]Removed[/h2]

Removed Weapons "Advanced Crafting"
Removed "M" Map from HUD
Removed the Weather from the game (Storm, Snow, Cloudy, Sandstorm and Fog)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43904910/f62fbf8263688c22eea66ba84f564b26cd19d157.png[/img]
Removed Main Menu Weather (Storm, Snow, Cloudy, Sandstorm and Fog)
